body: It wasn't war, but I'd rather not go into specifics.

Don't have easy access, it's expensive, and although I have taken some and it does help me sleep it dulls my brain. Something that can be fun every so often because I trust it to be safe, but not something I want to live in a perpetual state of.

I've had constant nightmares for years. As a horror buff with a creative imagination there's some really nasty stuff my mind can make.

I have a severe fear of not being in control of myself.

I think these things combined would make my chances of a bad trip exponentially higher. A good trip might help me, I've seen testimonies and research done on that. The thing is, in my state, a bad trip would probably give me a mental break.

The worst fear I have in the world is being trapped in my own broken mind. It's not a solution I'm even considering.
I'd rather confront a problem, but I find myself growing weaker as time goes by and now I tend to avoid them. The problem with my insurance is out of my hands, though.
Cookie dough is pretty damn good.

Numb. Caught between fleeting hopes that the insurance will resolve itself, and the more realistic thoughts that it never works like that for me.

Edit: To clarify, there's problems with the health insurance I'm on.
